name: tool-block
opens_with: (/voice to clear the boot notice, then an agent script)
notes: Tool blocks are a distinct render path (render_tool_items_lines) with four status colours (Queued / Running / Done / Error) and a 3-line output preview — exactly the kind of thing the style baseline exists for and the text dump cannot see. The script leads with a `user` event because build_transcript_turns starts a turn only at a Role::User message and render_messages partitions tool blocks onto a turn: without it the tool state populates and paints nothing. POST-CUTOVER: the ported tool block renders a generated title ('Reading the file.') + tool name + tokens, not the raw argument path; result text remains the content gate. 2026-10-12 P4-2 purge: the Done-path banner (and its wall-clock countdown bar) is deleted from the render, so the border-width drift driver is gone; scenario restored to deterministic and re-proven.
